title: Step-up turns ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the step-up transformer turns ratio as n1/n2 = 1/5 or 0.2.

title: Transmission line current
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the transmission line current using I = P_generator / U_transmission.

title: Transmission line resistance
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the line resistance from the power loss and transmission current.

title: Step-down input voltage
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the voltage at the step-down transformer primary using U3 = U_transmission - I*R_line.

title: Step-down turns ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the step-down transformer turns ratio as n3/n4 = 95/11 or approximately 8.636.

title: Confusing power values
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses the user's received power (9.5 kW) instead of the generator output power (10 kW) when calculating transmission current.

title: Voltage drop omission
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assumes the step-down transformer primary voltage equals the transmission voltage (2 kV) without accounting for line loss.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Award if the student explicitly shows unit analysis or dimensional consistency in their calculations.
